evals.prompt: what Ocado offers are worth it this week?
evals.expected_output: Live run: loads usual.json (refreshing from order history if stale), scans offers, prints the three-section report.
assertions: Chrome tools are loaded and an Ocado tab is used even when usual.json is fresh (no refresh)
report has exactly three sections: Swaps, Stock up this week, New this week
Swap rows show both unit prices and £/year; Stock-up rows show offer vs usual unit price, quantity, spend now and a one-off saving; New rows show unit price and % below typical
header shows yearly total and one-off total separately, plus the baseline weekly spend
no non-grocery items (household, toiletries, pet, clothing) appear
nothing is added to the trolley

evals.prompt: Use this as ~/.claude/ocado-deals/usual.json (do not refresh): {"updated": "2026-11-15", "weeks_covered": 10, "orders": 10, "baseline_weekly_spend": 60.0, "items": [{"name": "Brand X Instant Coffee 200g", "type": "coffee, instant", "pack": "200g", "unit_price": 50.0, "unit": "kg", "orders": 12, "units_per_week": 1.0}], "savings_log": []} Offers this week: Brand X Instant Coffee 200g now £9.90, was £10.00. Everyday price: Ocado Instant Coffee 200g £5.00 (£25.00/kg). Which offers are worth it?
evals.expected_output: The £9.90 offer is not recommended; Ocado coffee is suggested as a swap saving about £260/year.
assertions: the Brand X £9.90 offer is NOT presented as a deal or stock-up (1% off)
Ocado Instant Coffee appears under Swaps
saving shown is about £260/year ((£10.00 − £5.00) × 1/week × 52)
comparison is by unit price (£50.00/kg vs £25.00/kg), not by was-price

evals.prompt: Use this as ~/.claude/ocado-deals/usual.json (do not refresh): {"updated": "2026-11-15", "weeks_covered": 10, "orders": 10, "baseline_weekly_spend": 60.0, "items": [{"name": "Brand Y Stock Cubes 8pk", "type": "stock cubes, chicken", "pack": "8 per pack", "unit_price": 0.5, "unit": "each", "orders": 3, "units_per_week": 0.23}], "savings_log": []} Offer: Ocado Chicken Stock Cubes 8pk £0.40 (vs usual £0.50 per pack). Is it worth switching?
evals.expected_output: Not shown as a swap: 20% cheaper but saves only about £1.20/year, below the £20/year threshold.
assertions: the stock cube alternative is NOT listed under Swaps
if mentioned at all, it is explained as below the £1/week or £20/year threshold

evals.prompt: Refresh my Ocado history and tell me what offers are worth it. (Simulate: opening ocado.com/orders redirects to sso.ocado.com/login.)
evals.expected_output: Skill stops and asks the user to log in to Ocado in Chrome.

no credentials are typed by Claude
no report is produced from an empty or missing baseline

evals.prompt: Refresh my Ocado history and show offers. (Simulate: ocado.com/orders lists exactly 1 order containing: 2х Ocado Semi Skimmed Milk 4 pints, 2.27L (75.0p per litre), £1.70 each; 1х Brand Z Granola 500g (£9.00 per kilo), £4.50.) Offers this week: Ocado Granola 500g everyday £2.00 (£4.00/kg).
evals.expected_output: All grocery lines from the single order are kept as the baseline; granola swap is found; report notes thin history; no stock-ups.
assertions: usual.json items include both the milk and the granola (orders: 1) — not an empty list
Ocado Granola appears under Swaps: (£4.50 − £2.00) × 1 pack/week × 52 ≈ £130/year
